integrity: The exact four-site partition series and the known leading power/log enhancement are credited to primary prior literature; novelty is confined to exact leading constant and joint occupation weak limit. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
limitations: Only fixed finite balanced complete-bipartite graphs, positive chemical potential and edge repulsion, infinite-temperature asymptotics; no infinite-volume ordering or finite-temperature error bounds.
title: Logarithmic scale mixing and Dirichlet–Gamma limits for a balanced bipartite arithmetic Ising gas
